name: so4ag-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves a SO4AG source as /so4ag.json on your own domain, in front of any website.

SOURCE_URL.description: Leave empty to serve so4ag.json from the repository. Or the https address of your source, for example https://soqver.com/s/<your-source>/own/so4ag.json

DOMAIN.description: The domain the source belongs to, without https://. Leave empty to use the domain the Worker runs on.

REFRESH_SECONDS.description: How long one copy of a remote source is served before it is read again. At least 60.

MAX_STALE_SECONDS.description: How long the last good copy is served while the remote source cannot be reached. 0 turns this off.
